AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: This app is a local weather provider that delivers current weather conditions and multi-day weather forecasts. Operational Patterns: - Use 'getCapabilities' to discover what weather data, metrics, and locations are available. - Use 'getCurrentWeather' to retrieve current temperature, weather condition, humidity, pressure, and wind speed. - Use 'getWeatherForecast' to retrieve daily and hourly weather forecasts for saved locations.
